notes.title: February Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Progression Updates:
[/h3]
The Career Tab and the Season Tab have been merged into one screen that contains:
[list][*]A permanent 300-tier reward track that progresses based on your career level.[/list][list][list][*][i]Champions will be automatically granted rewards based on their current career level upon next login.[/i]
[/list][/list][list][*]Your Pro Quidditch rank and Emblem selection.
[/list][h3]Market and Currency Updates:
[/h3]
The Market has received a redesign and been refreshed with new items for every category:
[list][*]The Vault has been retired along with the Winged Keys currency, instead all items in the Market can be purchased using Gold.
[/list][list][list][*][i]Any champions that had winged keys in their wallet will have them converted into gold upon next login at a ratio of 1 winged Key to 5 gold.[/i]
[/list][/list][list][*]The Market now features multiple tabs that sort cosmetics by category for easy browsing.
[/list][h3]Challenge Updates:
[/h3]
[list][*]Daily and Weekly challenges have been removed.
[*]Career Challenges have had their rewards updated to accommodate market and progression changes.
[/list][list][list][*][i]Champions will automatically be granted rewards based on their challenge completion upon next login.[/i]
[/list][/list][h3]Custom Matches:
[/h3]
With this update comes Custom Matches, allowing players to create their own matches with a customized ruleset and then face off against their chosen opponents:
[list][*][b]Form the Teams[/b] – [i]Use the Party System to form two teams of up to 6 players each.[/i]
[*][b]Host the Game[/b] – [i]One team’s party leader creates the match, customizes the settings to their liking and selects their roles, once they’re done, a join code will be generated to pass to their competitor’s party leader. Game settings include:[/i]
[/list][list][list][*][i]Mode Selection[/i]
[*][i]Map Selection [/i]
[*][i]Score Limit[/i]
[*][i]Quaffle Score Value[/i]
[*][i]Snitch Score Value[/i]
[*][i]Snitch Fill Rate[/i]
[*][i]AI Difficulty[/i]
[*][i]Allow Bot Fill (Pro Quidditch only)[/i]
[/list][/list][list][*][b]Join the Game[/b] – [i]The other team will join the match by using the join code provided and selecting the roles they wish to play.[/i]
[*][b]Earn Rewards[/b] – [i]Players will earn both Career and Challenge progression while playing in Custom Matches.[/i]
[/list][h3]Map Changes:
[/h3]
[list][*]Added [i]Weasley’s Burrow (Snow)[/i] to Exhibition and Custom Match modes.
[*]Added a new Hogwarts map variant, [i]Hogwarts (Legacy)[/i], to Matchmaking, Exhibition and Custom Match modes.
[/list][h3]Gameplay Changes:
[/h3]
[list][*]The Chaser’s “Tackling” skill tree has been reorganized and rebalanced to focus on tackle radius increases and less on tackle damage. [i]By default, a Chaser will not be able to inflict damage when tackling an opponent, by utilizing the skill tree they can increase this to 1 point of damage (with 4 skill points invested).[/i]
[*]The Keeper’s “Kick Lunge” skill now reduces the lunge amount when you are far away from their goals – Keepers will travel the full lunge amount until they are around 40 meters away from their goal at which point the lunge amount tapers down to a minimum at 90 meters away.
[*]The impact of a Beater hitting the Quaffle with either a Bludger or a tackle has been increased.
[*]Added Ireland and Bulgaria as selectable teams in Exhibition matches.
[/list][h3]Bug Fixes:
[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed an issue preventing players from earning Challenge progress after rejoining a match.
[*]Fixed an issue causing players to get kicked back to the Main Menu when matchmaking.
[*]Fixed an issue that would prevent the player from earning the “Constant Vigilance” platform achievement if they were hit by a Bludger as a non-seeker role.
[*]Fixed an issue causing player models to occasionally become invisible - [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-623]HPQC-623[/url].
[*]Fixed an issue that would prevent the “A Superb Keeper” platform achievement from being granted when the player correctly performed a Power Save - [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-624]HPQC-624[/url].
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause the Beater’s “Quaffle Targeting” skill to consistently lose targeting on the Quaffle.
[*]Fixed an issue that would allow Pro Quidditch games to start without an opposing team, causing the game to instantly end in a forfeit.
[*]Fixed an issue that would allow the AI to perform a tackle or bump while stunned.
[*]Fixed an issue that would prevent the Lull VO lines from playing when the score was tied at 0-0 for a long time.
[*]Fixed an issue that would prevent the Announcer from using unique Hero lines - [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-774]HPQC-774[/url].
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause backfilling players to get stuck emoting on repeat.
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause the Durmstrang team to be flying on invisible brooms - [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-869]HPQC-869[/url]. 
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the Incoming Bludger warning to get stuck on the screen - [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-608]HPQC-608[/url].
[/list]

notes.title: December (V1.1.1) Update - 12/11/2024
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Balance/Tuning
[/h1]
[list][*]Updated the Keeper's dive ability to prevent them from overshooting their intended goal and make sure the tuning takes into account the speed stats of the equipped broom.
[*]Upped the default difficulty of backfill bots in Pro Quidditch to the maximum level.
[*]Increased the respawn time for all roles to 10 seconds (up from 7 seconds).
[/list]

[h1]Keeper Power Kick
[/h1]
[list][*]There were some issues identified with the Keeper and their Power Kick skillpoint incorrectly applying the Power Kick to the Quaffle - For clarification, a Keeper should apply the Power Kick to a Quaffle when one of the following is true:
[/list][list][list][*]They are kicking the Quaffle back into play after being scored on (regardless of skillpoint assignment or charge level of the kick)
[*]They have the Power Kick skillpoint equipped and kick a loose Quaffle with a perfectly charged kick.
[*]They have the Power Kick skillpoint equipped and kick an opposing player with possession of the Quaffle with a perfectly charged kick.
[/list][/list][list][*]With the above in mind, the following bugs have been fixed:
[/list][list][list][*]Fixed a bug that prevented a Keeper with the Power Kick skillpoint equipped from applying the power kick to a Quaffle that was held by an opposing Chaser at the time of the kick.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed a Keeper with the Power Kick skillpoint equipped to sometimes apply the power kick to a Quaffle they kicked from their own possession.
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the Keeper to kick the Quaffle to themselves when they had a teammate targeted.
[/list][/list]

[h1]General Bugfixing
[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed various crashes.
[*]Fixed a bug that enabled aim assist in Pro Quidditch mode.
[*]Fixed a bug that applied the reduced Snitch Meter reduction on Bludger hit from Pro Quidditch to Casual Quidditch.
[*]Fixed a bug that would apply a Copper rank to any player who managed to get above 10,000 SR
[*]Fixed an issue causing the Postmatch experience gained to not be accurately reflected in the Season XP displayed on the Season Tab. [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-627]HPQC-627[/url]
[*]Fixed an issue that cause Postmatch scores to appear the same for both teams in Cup Modes.
[*]Fixed an issue causing Keepers to overshoot the hoop. [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-612]HPQC-612[/url]
[/list]

[h1]Holiday Content
[/h1]
[list][*]Added new cosmetic content for upcoming holiday events!
[/list]

notes.title: Season 1 - 11/06/2024
notes.content:
Welcome to season 1 of Harry Potter: Quidditch Champions, Defence Against the Dark Arts! With the start of the new season comes new cosmetics, new events, and an exciting new 6v6 game mode, Pro Quidditch. We know how much you've been asking for it, so Pro Quidditch will act as our first iteration of a light ranking system where players can compete to see just how skilled they are. Additionally, this patch comes with a few balance changes and bug fixes to improve gameplay. We've still been seeing Chasers out-performing Keepers by a bit too large of a margin so seasoned players will notice that we've decreased the size of the goal rings. We find that it's easier to express a higher level of skill as a Chaser compared to Keeper so we wanted scoring goals to require just a bit more skill and precision. We've also made the keeper dive work a bit more smoothly. While its speed has not increased, it will no longer slow down prematurely when diving towards a goal. Along with these changes comes a set of crash and bug fixes that should help game stability. Let us know what you think, and we'll see you all on the pitch!

[h1]6v6 mode
[/h1]
[list]
[*]Players now pick any of the 4 roles before entering a match and will play this role for the entirety of the match. Role swapping is not available in 6v6.
[*]The Snitch and the Seeker are on the field at all times during a match.
[list]
[*]The Snitch race has been tweaked to account for the extended time on the field:
[*]Time to fill the Snitch Meter has been increased.
[*]Reduced the amount of Snitch Meter removed by a Bludger hit to 2.5% (from 5%).
[*]Reduced the amount of Snitch Meter removed by being eliminated to 10% (from 25%).
[*]The catch-up mechanic for Seekers on a team trailing 30 points or more has been removed.
[*]The respawn time for all roles has been reduced to 7 seconds (from 20 seconds).
[/list][*]Party System:
[list][*]Allow parties to include up to 6 players and altered the party UI to accommodate them.
[*]When playing as a Chaser in 6v6, the Chaser positioned adjacent to your Keeper determines your cosmetic loadout (Chaser Skill Points and Broom Stats are universally applied to all Chasers).
[/list][*]Matches will not start with Bots, but, similarly to 3v3 Mode, they will fill in when Players drop (until a new player can be found to backfill the empty slot).
[*]Skillpoints and Broom Stats are present in 6v6.
[*]We are experimenting with 6v6 mode as our first foray into a ranked game mode. 
[list]
[*]Players can view their current rank and skill rating (SR) in the career tab.
[*]Winning increases SR. Losing decreases SR.
[*]Leaving a match early results in a SR penalty.
[/list]
[/list][h1]Gameplay Balance/Tuning
[/h1]
[list][*]Decreased goal ring sizes.
[*]Adjusted nameplate and role icon visibility to be more uniform across all roles.
[*]Re-enabled Aim Assist for Campaign Mode difficulties lower than Champion.
[list]
[*]Aim Assist remains off in PvP matches and Champion Difficulty.
[/list][*]Added settings to "Gameplay" tab that allow players to adjust their Keeper's camera settings. Players can adjust pitch, height, and distance.
[*]Balanced Keeper dive to no longer excessively slow down before they reach the center of their target ring.
[/list][h1]Challenges
[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue that would allow unsuccessful Seeker bumps to increment the “Any Hits” daily challenge.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the dedication career challenge, “Matches Won”, to restart each tier from 0. Going forward, progress will correctly carry over to the next tier. [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-334]HPQC-334[/url]
[*]Updated the player's methods of unlocking the cups and their difficulties. 
[list]
[*]By default, all cups will come with both casual and standard difficulty when unlocked.
[*]Challenges that unlock cups / difficulties now take into account completions on both their target difficulty and higher difficulties.
[/list][*]Fixed typos / inconsistencies in some challenge descriptions.
[/list][h1]Character Customization:
[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed some grouping issues on customization screens, including brooms, facewear, heroes, and emblems.
[*]Fixed inconsistencies in some item names. 
[/list][h1]Store:
[/h1]
[list][*]Added new Season 1 “Defence Against the Dark Arts” reward track (Season Rank will be reset).
[*]Added new Season 1 items to the Market.
[*]Added new Season 1 items to the Vault.
[*]Added items from Season 0 “Quidditch Tryouts” rewards track to the Vault. 
[*]Added items from the Legacy Heroes event to the Vault. 
[*]Added items from the Halloween event to the Vault.
[*]Added new Broom Drop event: “Makeshift” broom model.

[/list][h1]General Bugfixing
[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed multiple crashes.
[*]Fixed an issue causing Beaters to occasionally get stuck in their Summoning animation loop.
[*]Fixed an issue causing Beaters to occasionally become unable to lock onto a valid target. [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-248]HPQC-248[/url]
[*]Corrected text on several skill points.
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause players to get flung in a random direction when performing a homing tackle on a ball that was picked up by another player. [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-366]HPQC-366[/url]
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented a Keeper's neutral kicks from homing towards allied Chasers
[*]Fixed a bug that incorrectly allowed the Chaser's “One-Timer” skill to kick a Quaffle under the effect of a Hero Kick.
[*]Fixed an issue that occasionally caused a Quaffle thrown by a Keeper to get stuck in the ground and become impossible for Chasers to pick up.
[/list]

notes.title: Day 35 (V1.0.2) Update
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Balance/Tuning
[/h1]
[list][*]Slightly lowered Chaser’s maximum turn speed to make it harder to fake out Keepers.
[*]Increased distance at which Seekers’ and Keepers’ nameplates remain visible to Keepers and Beaters.
[*]Adjusted Bludger targeting to favor targets in center of screen over closer targets.
[*]Added more Bronze medals and made several Platinums easier to achieve for Beaters and Keepers.
[*]Adjusted Seeker bump to add more backwards force to Seekers so players are less likely to accidentally help their opponent by bumping them towards the Snitch.
[*]Reduced rep counts for Daily and Weekly Challenge completion.
[*]Chaser and Keeper AI Improvements:
[list]
[*]Improved Chaser AI pass positioning and logic, including when to Call for Pass.
[*]Improved defensive positioning and Dive to Hoops logic for Keepers.
[*]Increased Keeper AI’s chance to kick incoming Bludgers while at low health.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Stability
[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed multiple crashes.[/list]
[h1]
[/h1]
[h1]General
[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue preventing Challenges related to customization from completing in non-English languages. [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-114]HPQC-114[/url]
[*]Fixed an issue causing AI Chasers to sometimes get stuck following Pass Target. 
[*]Fixed an issue improperly multiplying Bludger Intercept Range based on Skill Points.
[*]Fixed an issue causing the Emblem preview to not appear on the Career tab.
[*]Fixed collision on Weasley Burrow goal rings.
[*]Fixed issues preventing some Trophies/Achievements from unlocking properly when the criteria was met. [url=https://quidditchchampions.bugs.wbgames.com/bug/HPQC-134]HPQC-134[/url] 
[*]Fixed an issue that broke homing when Shovel Passing backwards.
[*]Fixed a couple display issues caused by Alt-Tabbing out while in Fullscreen mode.
[*]Fixed an issue causing the Skills Tab to rapidly blink/reload.
[*]Fixed issues with broken character lighting when Shadows were set to Medium.
[*]Fixed flickering character models when cycling through customization options.
[*]Fixed an issue that would allow two snitches to spawn during the Seeker Training.
[*]Adjusted transition from “Waiting for Players” to “Warmup” from 30 sec to 15.
[*]Updated Career Tab to rotate through rewards so rewards are visible if there are multiple per level.
[*]Added new hair and eyebrow colors to customization.
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause the 'Quaffle Near Goal' warning to appear during Keeper Playcaller at incorrect times.
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause the player to become soft-locked while swapping roles in Open Practice.
[*]Added new content, challenges, and more for an upcoming spooky event![/list]
[h1]
[/h1]
[h1]Matchmaking
[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue occasionally preventing rejoins to matches in progress.
[*]Fixed an issue preventing people from joining parties while on the Credits screen.[/list]
[h1]
[/h1]
[h1]Audio
[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where commentator lines were duplicating at the end of World Cup matches.
[*]Fixed an issue causing some commentators to play Latin American Spanish when set to European Spanish.
[/list]


[h1]PC Only
[/h1]
[list][*]Enabled Numpad for selecting options in wheel menus.
[*]Gameplay now pauses when a controller is disconnected.
[/list]

notes.title: Quidditch Champions is Steam Deck Verified!

notes.title: Brooms, Talent Trees, Customization, and Challenges
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=1ywbRtMYiY8;full][/previewyoutube]
🏆 If you’re going to be a Quidditch Champion, you’ll be needing a broom! In Quidditch Champions, players will be able to obtain a variety of brooms from different manufacturers like Nimbus, Firebolt and more! These brooms will have differing base stats based on the manufacturer they come from.

🧹 Through play, you’ll be able to collect new cosmetic models (like the Nimbus 2000, 2001, etc.), new broom manufacturers and Moonstones to upgrade each set of manufactured brooms.

🔥 These upgrades include improvements to max speed, durability upgrades to boost max health, agility upgrades to advance maneuverability, drift, and more!

[previewyoutube=ck15U-1CS1E;full][/previewyoutube]
In Quidditch Champions you’ll earn skill points throughout your career. Mix, match and experiment with these points to improve stats and unlock special moves to build your perfect playstyle for each position. Upgrade your tackles as a Chaser, do more Bludger damage as a Beater, increase your boost energy as a Seeker, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050900/7ea89881780d3b04a353dacf8c25d0343677838c.jpg[/img]
✨ Players can customize up to 6 characters on their Team, representing every available role. Players can fill these character slots with Hero characters like Harry Potter or create their own original characters!

⚡️ For Hero Characters, you’ll be able to customize their look by applying alternate outfits. For your Player-created characters, you can customize their body type, hair style and color, outfits, personal insignias, emotes, broom trails and much more!

💥 Players will also be able to select emotes for use during matches and a victory celebration to play at the end of matches (only if you’re the victor, of course!). For the Chaser role, you’ll also be able to customize your goal VFX for when you score!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050900/e83a4aeb46e8bca9bbc87af60ca5480b384e7aae.jpg[/img]
You’ll be rewarded for participating in a variety of daily, weekly and career gameplay challenges! The daily and weekly challenges award Winged Keys that can be used in The Vault! But the Career Challenge rewards, which can include gold, Exhibition Mode unlockables, outfits and emblems are unlocked only once!

notes.title: Exploring Career, Multiplayer, and Exhibition Mode
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YObpr-3G_e4;full][/previewyoutube]
When you step on the Pitch in #QuidditchChampions, you'll be playing in 6v6 matches, with bots filling out at least 3 roles per team. Playing solo, you'll be able to swap between any of the 6 players on your team at will. In Multiplayer, players will select from a combination of roles (Chaser/Keeper, Chaser/Beater, or Chaser/Seeker) and can swap between their chosen two positions throughout play with their bot taking control of the remaining role!

✨ In Career Mode, you'll play your way through 4 exciting Championship Cups! You can play through all of these Cups solo, with the ability to hop between each position and take over that role from your bot allies, or team up with up to 2 friends to go head-to-head with bot allies versus the computer. 

🏆 In the Burrow Cup, you'll learn the basics of flight and position training, and you'll show your house pride in the Hogwarts House Quidditch Cup by playing for your favorite Hogwarts house team! Our third Cup will remain a bit of a secret for now, but once you’ve secured victory over those opponents, you’ll move onto the Quidditch World Cup! Here you’ll play as one of 16 nations and compete in qualifying rounds before going onto the finals to become the ultimate Quidditch Champion!

[previewyoutube=OUhEwhoFJeY;full][/previewyoutube]
In Multiplayer, you’ll be competing against your fellow rising stars! Either party up beforehand or join matchmaking to group with up to 2 other players. Each player can swap between their two roles throughout the match, with their bot taking control of the remaining position.

💥 Players can join matchmaking with a preferred role combination in mind (Chaser/Keeper, Chaser/Beater, or Chaser/Seeker) or select “Any Role” to quickly fill an empty roster spot and hop right into the action. #QuidditchChampions

[previewyoutube=GMQLj3qOuLk;full][/previewyoutube]
Exhibition Mode allows you and your party to create a fantasy Quidditch scenario based on what you’ve unlocked by completing career challenges. Play as any team, against any team, at any difficulty, on any map! #QuidditchChampions
